text:
You need help with straightforward Python, SQL, and Jupyter Notebook tasks, with the possibility of more work if things go well.  

I’m Noor Halden, and I have 6 years of experience working with Python and machine learning tools. I’d be glad to help with the current tasks and give practical advice as needed. I’ve also built a support ticket triage model for Kettlewell Support Co. using Python and scikit-learn, served through FastAPI with nightly retraining via Celery on Redis. It routed tickets to 14 queues, improved macro-F1 to 0.88 from 0.62, and reduced median routing time from 6 hours to 4 minutes.  

If you’d like, I can help you get through the current notebook and SQL work efficiently and keep things clean and maintainable for future tasks.
